say:1:1441127001:0.text: I think I know why Ravion sent me here—maybe he wanted to test the truth I spoke of.
say:1:1441127001:0.source_cn: 沙利叶让我前往地表的目的，或许是为了验证我说出口的“真相”。

say:2:1441127002:0.text: If I can return without any sign of corruption, it will prove my curse is lifted, and that the world above ground is nothing like the Queen described.
say:2:1441127002:0.source_cn: 我能够没有孽化迹象地回来，就向世人证明了我的诅咒已经解...

say:3:1441127003:0.text: It will show that we could have lived freely under the sun, relishing the breeze and rain.
say:3:1441127003:0.source_cn: ——证明我们本可以自由地生活在阳光下，沐浴微风和雨露。

say:4:1441127004:0.text: It's time to break free from the curse that has run through our blood for thousands of years.
say:4:1441127004:0.source_cn: 艾塞勒血脉中延续千年的诅咒……到了挣脱的时候了。
